items.description: Report does not tie the totalBackingSigned() read to a specific transaction/checkpoint relative to slot activation, so the temporal ordering of the halt is only qualitatively stated.
Whether the slot is inactive at read time is conditional ('may not exist yet'); the scenario is potential, not observed.

Report states the slot may not be active yet only conditionally ('may not exist yet', 'if the slot is not actually active yet'); the potential scenario is encoded as the inactive-slot subcase rather than an observed state.
The exact checkpoint at which totalBackingSigned() is later called is not tied to a specific transaction in the report.
